description: Set video clips' built-in Motion (or Vector Motion, for graphics) and Opacity settings (Effect Controls): position, scale, rotation, anchor point, anti-flicker, opacity and blend mode, for placing and compositing clips over the tracks below. Values are in the units list_clip_effects reports. An animated setting is refused unless clearKeyframes is true. One undo step

blendMode.description: Blend Mode, by its name in the Opacity menu

blendModeIndex.description: Blend Mode as the index Premiere Pro stores, instead of blendMode

clearKeyframes.description: Turn animation off for the settings given (removes their keyframes). Default false

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

motion.description: Motion settings (Vector Motion with vectorMotion: true)

scale.description: Scale (Scale Height when uniform scale is off)

scaleWidth.description: Scale Width (used when uniform scale is off)

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

vectorMotion.description: Set the Vector Motion effect of graphics clips instead of Motion. Default false

name: set_clip_transform
title: Set Clip Transform
